patch_description: Transitions the optimization scheme to a Direct Successive Over-Relaxation (SOR) Pointwise Solver. I derive the exact first-order derivatives for the true objectives (Path length = Spring Tension, School Proximity = Inverse 4th order force, Base Proximity = Linear distance pull) and map them mathematically to localized displacements. I then wrap this physics-like simulation in a 3000-sweep scheduler smoothly shifting from a "carving phase" (high beta:school repulsion) to a "fine-tuning phase" (high gamma:base attraction). This elegantly leverages Gauss-Seidel stability and achieves smooth global deflections without exploding learning gradients.
